note: Build-time compressor only (tools/build.mjs, images/codec-build.mjs); never bundled. dist/index.js, dist/libzopfli.js and dist/libzopfli-wasm.json are the published files; the one `require("base64-js")` in libzopfli.js is rewritten to ./base64-js.js, a Buffer-backed shim of the same two functions, so the build keeps needing no package install. Zopfli output is ordinary gzip: the shell decodes it with DecompressionStream("gzip") unchanged.
